newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim buys engine maker for $8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim buys engine maker for $8 mln.

text.p: Polish trading and industrial conglomerate Elektrim SA bought 80 percent of the country's leading electrical engine maker Maszyny Elektryczne Celma SA for $8 million, Elektrim said.
It said in a statement it bought the shares from Celma's parent company Zaklady Elektromaszynowe Celma SA and said the remaining 20 percent of shares would be taken by the firm's employees.
Elektrim, which has majority stakes in two other Polish electrical engines producers Indukta and Besel pledged to invest $5 million in Celma in the next three years.
Celma, based in Cieszyn, southern Poland, employs 820 people. No financial data of the company was revealed.
